svg.title: Expanse
svg.desc: Windows on one big canvas, seen zoomed out. A lit frame marks the part your screen shows, with the windows outside it dimmed. The frame glides from window to window while the windows stay where they are, and the minimap follows it.

g.text: your Mac, on an infinite canvas
Your screen is a view onto one big canvas. Your windows stay put.
Zoom out, click any window, and the view glides to it.
arrow keys hop to the next window.
